docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The king of Thebes searches for the murderer of Laius and finds himself: the tragedy that Aristotle held up as the model of the form.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Sophocles (about 496–406 BC), Oidipous Tyrannos (Greek), about 429 BC, translated by Francis Storr (1839–1919), Loeb Classical Library, 1912. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
